**Plan, no changes made.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) already carries the full data, `owner` and `slow` included. Table format just drops columns it can't fit.

1. Add `--json` parsing in [cli.js:9](src/cli.js:9).
2. If set, print `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)` instead of calling `toTable`.
3. No changes needed to `report.js` or `format.js`.

Same "same data" question you raised: JSON output would include `owner` and `slow`, text table won't. Worth confirming that's intended before I build it.
